name: bond-network-demo
description: Tiny CASPULE / LAMMPS bond-network demo: three bonded atoms under a Langevin thermostat. Emits temperature, total_energy, num_bonds, and bond_energy each step, and bundles two Visualization Steps: BondNetworkPlots (Plotly time-series) and BondNetwork3D (three.js orbitable atom/bond viewer).

interval.description: Process interval in LAMMPS time units. The bridge issues `run N` calls sized to fit this window.

cluster_max_atoms.description: Skip connected-component cluster computation when system size exceeds this. Default is plenty for the 3-atom demo.

viz_title.description: Title for the Plotly time-series figure.

viz_3d_title.description: Title for the three.js 3D atom/bond viewer.

config.input_script:
units lj
atom_style bond
boundary p p p
neighbor 0.4 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0
region box block 0 8 0 8 0 8
create_box 1 box bond/types 1 extra/bond/per/atom 4
mass 1 1.0
create_atoms 1 single 1.0 4.0 4.0
create_atoms 1 single 2.0 4.0 4.0
create_atoms 1 single 3.0 4.0 4.0
create_bonds single/bond 1 1 2
create_bonds single/bond 1 2 3
pair_style lj/cut 1.5
pair_coeff * * 1.0 1.0 1.5
bond_style harmonic
bond_coeff 1 100.0 1.0
fix nve all nve
fix lan all langevin 0.4 0.4 1.0 12345
timestep 0.005
thermo 1
